arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test various timezone formats
fmt = 'a {:ti} b'

tests = [
    ('+0100', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b'),
    ('+01:00', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+01:00 b'),
    ('-0530', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20-0530 b'),
    ('-05:30', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20-05:30 b'),
    ('+1000', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+1000 b'),
    ('+10:00', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+10:00 b'),
]

for name, t in tests:
    result = parse.parse(fmt, t)
    if result:
        tz = result[0].tzinfo
        print(f'{name:8} -> name={tz._name}, offset_sec={tz._offset.total_seconds()}')
    else:
        print(f'{name:8} -> None')
"
